sources.note: COMSTECH's own programme page for the Fellowships for Research and Advanced Training in Virology and Vaccine Technologies, read in full (comstech.org is the organisation's own domain; the page carries the Secretariat's address and @comstech.org contacts).

awarding_body.detail: The page is hosted on COMSTECH's own domain and names COMSTECH (with the Host Institutions Joint Fellowships Committee) as the awarder, matching the record's awarding body.
awarding_body.quote: Fellowships are awarded by COMSTECH, along with Host Institutions Joint Fellowships Committee, based on scientific merit.

deadline.detail: No closing date is published. Under 'Call Status' the page states the call is currently open, matching the record's rolling deadline label exactly (checked 12 October 2026).

eligibility.detail: All record claims confirmed: citizens of OIC member states; young scientists employed by a research institution in an OIC country; M.S. in Biomedical/Health Sciences for graduate studies or Ph.D. for post-graduate studies; age limits 35 (graduate) and 45 (post-graduate); preference for women scientists, early-career scientists, and those working in OIC LDCs or Muslim-majority areas in non-OIC states.
eligibility.quote: Eligible applicants for the fellowships are young scientists working in any area of biomedical sciences who are citizens of an OIC country, and are employed by a research institution in an OIC country.

funding.detail: Partially funded, as the record says: COMSTECH provides international low-cost airfare for a visit of at most three months; the host institution is expected to provide subsistence, supervision and training. No tuition, stipend or full-cost support is covered.
funding.quote: COMSTECH will provide international low-cost airfare. The host institutions are expected to provide subsistence supervision, and mentor local trainings.

degree_levels.detail: The record's single 'PhD' level cannot be confirmed as stated. The page describes a 3-month research and advanced training fellowship (no degree is awarded) with two applicant tracks: graduate studies (minimum M.S. in Biomedical/Health Sciences, age limit 35) and post-graduate studies (minimum Ph.D. in Biomedical/Health Sciences, age limit 45). 'PhD' omits the graduate/M.S. track.
degree_levels.quote: They are offered to young scientists holding at least an M.S. in Biomedical/Health Sciences or equivalent degree for graduate studies, and Ph.D. in Biomedical/Health Sciences for post-graduate studies.

recommended_field_updates.deadline_text: The call is currently open (no closing date published; applications by email or the online form to the COMSTECH Secretariat, Islamabad)
recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Page read live 2026-10-12; call status 'currently open', rolling, no closing date. Funding is partial: COMSTECH covers international low-cost airfare for a maximum three-month visit at a host centre of excellence in another OIC country; host institutions provide subsistence and supervision. Degree levels in the record ('PhD') are imprecise: the call has graduate (minimum M.S., age limit 35) and post-graduate (minimum Ph.D., age limit 45) tracks and awards no degree. Country 'Multiple' is consistent with 'Eligible Countries: All OIC member states'; the record's region 'Middle East' understates this.

notes_for_reviewer: A human should decide the degree_levels value: the page supports 'M.S./Ph.D. (short research training fellowship; no degree awarded)' rather than 'PhD' alone, and whether region should be 'Multiple' instead of 'Middle East'. Everything else (awarding body, rolling open call, eligibility, partial funding) matches the record verbatim.
